if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
the invoice was prepared in the manner prescribed under rule 48(4)
then: where the invoice was prepared under rule 48(4), the tax invoice MUST carry a Quick Response code with the Invoice Reference Number embedded in it
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(r), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: Quick Response code, having embedded Invoice Reference Number (IRN) in it, in case invoice has been issued in the manner prescribed under sub-rule (4) of rule 48
evidence.extraction_note: Clause (r) appears in the source inside square brackets with the footnote marker '107' attached ('...of rule 48]107.'); footnote 107 reads 'Inserted vide Notf no. 72/2020-CT dt. 30.09.2020.' The quote stops before the bracket and the marker.
